items.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
items.description: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after storms hit US on Thanksgiving
items.description: Pennsylvania and neighbouring states remain badly affected on Friday after both coasts were lashed with wind and rain.

items.title: Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in
items.description: The struggle many face in buying a home has been the biggest issue of a bitter campaign.

items.title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
items.description: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.

items.title: Ex-media executive admits saying Australian child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
items.description: The former Murdoch media executive was overheard at an event referring to the way Grace Tame was dressed.

items.title: Mushroom murderer Erin Patterson launches last-ditch High Court appeal
items.description: Erin Patterson is serving life in prison for poisoning her relatives with a toxic mushroom lunch in 2023.

items.title: Clashes mar European games as Macron condemns violence
items.description: Violent clashes mar a number of European football matches on Thursday night, with French president Emmanuel Macron condemning trouble at Marseille's home game against Levski Sofia.

items.title: Venezuela to scrap law that bars opposition from public office
items.description: The legislation has been criticised for enabling political persecution since it was introduced two years ago.

items.title: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
items.description: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

items.title: EU leaders fail to bridge budget splits as talks stall
items.description: Aid for Ukraine was among the disputes as EU members hope to conclude talks by the end of the year.

items.title: Uganda to withdraw troops from DR Congo town amid diplomatic row
items.description: The Ugandan army is helping the Congolese military fight an Islamist militant group in the east of the country.

items.title: India busts cyberfraud and trafficking network rescuing 164 foreigners
items.description: Lured by IT job promises, the victims were allegedly forced into cybercrime, police say.

items.title: Guinea-Bissau's military leaders delay return to civilian rule until 2028
items.description: The announcement comes a year after a military coup with its leaders promising a return to civilian rule within 12 months.

items.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
items.description: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

items.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
items.description: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

items.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
items.description: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

items.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
items.description: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

items.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
items.description: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.

items.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
items.description: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

items.title: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
items.description: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.
